links.comparator_used: Original static random forest model trained on 2013 data and never updated, compared with temporally updated models, 2014-2023
links.outcome: Fairness gaps (metric parity between disadvantaged and advantaged groups by race and sex) and overall performance (discrimination, calibration, accuracy) for 30-day post-surgical readmission, mortality, and pneumonia
links.effect: No numeric effect sizes reported in the text. Updating had a larger impact on overall performance than on fairness gaps. During stable fairness periods, updating increased, decreased, or did not change fairness gaps. During fairness drift, updating restored fairness in some cases and exacerbated gaps in others.
links.tradeoff: Population-level model updating could exacerbate fairness gaps in some cases, and fairness drift occurred in both the original and updated models.
links.quote: During periods of fairness drift, updating models restored fairness in some cases and exacerbated fairness gaps in others.

design_hint: periodic model updating / drift monitoring for fairness
